speaker: Perrin
text: I’m not going to pretend Emberwing is quiet. It isn’t. It’s a room full of people who’d rather do something than stand back and discuss doing it.

speaker: Kai
text: I have met exactly one of those people.

speaker: Perrin
text: And he made a spectacular mess of a market awning. Yes, yes.

speaker: Perrin
text: But you saw what happened when the cart fell. I charged. You charged. Neither of us checked whether the other needed us.

speaker: Perrin
text: Emberwing can teach us when to move together. We might even learn when not to charge at all. I make no promises about how fast.

speaker: Kai
text: That sounds like a terrible sales pitch.

speaker: Perrin
text: It’s an honest one. Come meet the rest of us, and then decide whether we’re your sort of terrible.
